description.value: The DoubleTree by Hilton North Vancouver is a full-service hotel situated in North Vancouver's Capilano area, part of the globally recognized Hilton family of brands. It sits within easy cycling distance of the North Shore trail network, Capilano River, and the Lynn Valley corridor, making it a practical base for cyclists exploring the area. Touring cyclists can expect the standard amenities of a large hotel brand, though specific cyclist-focused services are unverified.
